name: Elevated Barber Lounge

reviews.text: Made an appointment in just a few minutes easily online, got there and the atmosphere was very inviting, and happy. Got my son a haircut he was unsure what he wanted and Mason was very patient and showed him some photos until he decided what he wanted. Would for sure recommend and we will be coming back! 10/10
reviews.author: Aimee Albrecht

reviews.text: Best barbershop in town! When I first moved to Salem I didn’t know any good barbershops, went to one downtown and was highly disappointed. A month later I went to you guys and Joey did a phenomenal job! It’s been about a year and a half since living here and I keep coming back. Truly amazing people and very welcoming. I recommend everyone to come here everyone does an amazing job and are super friendly!
reviews.author: Luis Guevara

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Elevated Barber Shop here in Salem. The atmosphere is clean, comfortable, and really welcoming, and the whole team takes pride in their work.

Huge shoutout to Joey and Mauricio!  both of them are incredibly skilled and detail-oriented. Mauricio gave me one of the cleanest fades I’ve had in a long time, and Joey's line-up and finishing touches were on point. They both take their time, listen to what you want, and make sure you walk out feeling fresh.

If you’re looking for a reliable, top-tier barbershop in Salem, this is the spot. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Quis

reviews.text: My teenage boys and I absolutely love Titus! He is one of the best barbers we’ve been to. He listens to what you want, checks in during the cut, and makes sure everything comes out clean and even.  He’s professional, friendly, and the shop has a great vibe. I Highly recommended if you want a fresh and precise cut.”
reviews.author: Cherenet Demme

reviews.text: Mason was dope! I came in a bit late and he still took his time and was thorough even though they were past close! Great vibe in the shop too full of laughs and good dudes. mason is most definitely gonna be my go to from now on!
reviews.author: Jesse Dana
